description: Figure 8 is a pie chart titled "Problem distribution based on the correctness under the w/ knowledge and w/o knowledge settings using Zero-Shot." The light gray slice, which appears to represent the largest category, occupies approximately 60% of the pie. The dark gray slice represents the second largest category, accounting for roughly 30%. The white slice, representing the smallest category, makes up about 10%. The chart includes a legend indicating the color correspondence for each category, although the specific labels for each slice are not visible within the image itself. There are no percentage labels directly inside the slices, and none of the slices appear to be exploded or emphasized visually. The three segments are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top, with the largest segment positioned at the top left.
